Client-manager 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a comprehensive freelancer CRM assistant for tracking clients, projects, leads, invoices, payments, and earnings.
- Supports commands for adding/viewing clients, managing projects, generating invoices, logging payments, tracking time, setting retainers, handling proposals, and running earnings or tax reports.
- Implements first-run setup to initialize all necessary data files and gather business information for invoices.
- Stores all data locally in organized JSON files within `~/.openclaw/client-manager/`.
- Provides proactive command suggestions and helpful dashboards for daily freelance operations.
